businesses.business: experiential specialty retailer of build-your-own stuffed animals

offering_description.value: Sells customizable plush toys that customers stuff, dress and personalize in store, plus clothing, accessories and licensed plush. Sells to families and gift buyers through its own stores, e-commerce, and franchise and wholesale partners.

primary_products.value: stuffed plush animals; plush clothing and accessories; licensed character plush; gift and collectible items

primary_services.value: in-store build-a-bear experience; birthday party events; franchise licensing

customer_segment.value: B2C: children, parents, gift buyers and collectors; B2B: franchisees, wholesale and licensing partners, commercial retail partners

end_markets.value: toys and plush; children's entertainment; gifts; experiential retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: plush, apparel and accessories sold in stores, online and to wholesale partners; licensing or royalties: franchise fees and royalties from international franchisees and licensed partners

value_chain_position.value: retailer: operates company-owned stores and e-commerce selling to consumers; brand owner: designs products made by contract manufacturers, sold under its own brand and licenses

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, UK and Ireland company-owned stores, franchise locations in Europe, Asia, Middle East, Africa, Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: plush retail, e-commerce, franchising and commercial licensing around one brand

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned stores in malls, tourist locations, and shopping destinations; online: company e-commerce websites; partners / resellers: international franchisees and third-party wholesale retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: children's product safety rules such as CPSIA and toy safety standards, plus import tariffs and data privacy
